description: This file contains a sample Android Java class demonstrating the use of PorterDuff transfer modes (Xfermode) to blend images in graphics programming. It defines methods to create source and destination bitmaps, and a custom View that draws multiple examples of blending modes with labels.

classes.name: Xfermodes
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating graphic blending modes.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Custom View that displays various blending modes with sample images.

methods.name: makeDst
methods.description: Creates a bitmap with a circle used as the destination image.

methods.name: makeSrc
methods.description: Creates a bitmap with a rectangle used as the source image.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity with the custom sample view.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the blending mode samples onto the canvas.
